Mock Packs

CSCA mock test papers and mock packs

These CSCA mock test papers and mock packs are built for students who already know their route and want to move from study into realistic paper-based practice. Start with the subject that truly matters to your application, not the one that simply looks easiest.

Format

Download-first digital mock test papers

Best For

Students moving from review into realistic practice

Price Range

$5.99 to $9.99 in the current launch set

Buy the pack that removes your next real problem

If your route is still unclear, do not start with a narrow subject pack. Use the subject picker or starter bundle first.

If math is definitely part of your route, the math pack is the strongest first purchase because it fits the widest range of applicants.

If you already know you are on an engineering, medicine, or Chinese-taught route, choose the subject pack that matches the scoring pressure in that pathway.

Go to Mock Test HubChoose Subjects First

Choose your prep stage

Start with the broadest pack if you need the safest first purchase, move into science or Chinese-focused packs once the route is already confirmed, and always use the free sample before checkout if you need more confidence.

Best first purchase

Start with Math

Math is the broadest and safest first pack for students who already know it belongs in their route and need structured timed practice.

Best for route-confirmed students

Go narrower when the route is confirmed

Physics, chemistry, and humanities Chinese packs are best once you already know the subject belongs in your target major and teaching-language pathway.

Best for early-stage users

Use the Starter Bundle if you still need clarity

If you are still deciding which subject direction matters most, the starter bundle is a better first step than buying the wrong single-subject pack.

What you get from these mock test papers

Know your real score direction before the official exam window arrives.

Find weak spots earlier so you can move back into the syllabus or practice layer with purpose.

Save study time by choosing the pack that matches your route instead of buying random papers.

Instant digital delivery

Use the free sample before purchase if you want to confirm the paper style first.

Each pack is built as a digital delivery product, so the fastest path is sample → product page → checkout.

If you still are not sure what to buy, go back to subjects, practice, or the mock-test hub instead of guessing.

Read the Mock Test GuideSee Sample Questions

Mock packs belong after the prep decision is already clear

This page should solve the purchase stage, not act as the whole exam-preparation system. If the route still feels uncertain, go back to the prep hubs and return only after the syllabus, subject mix, practice layer, and mock direction make sense.
